mcqs.learning_point: Understand that continents contain diverse physical environments
mcqs.question: Africa is described as having deserts, rainforests, mountains, and savannas. Which statement best reflects this description?

options.A: All continents have the same type of physical environment
options.C: Only Africa has varied physical environments
options.D: Physical environments are determined only by latitude

mcqs.explanation: The correct answer highlights that a continent can include many different physical environments such as deserts, forests, mountains, and plains. Option A is wrong because continents differ; C is wrong because other continents also have varied environments; D is wrong because many factors besides latitude shape environments.

mcqs.question: A student writes down Asia, Africa, Europe, North America, South America, Antarctica and Australia. Which task has the student just completed?

options.A: Listing the major oceans of the world

mcqs.explanation: The list contains exactly the seven continents taught in the curriculum. Options A, C, and D refer to different geographical categories and are therefore incorrect.

mcqs.learning_point: Locate continents on a world map
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about world‑map locations is correct?

options.B: Africa is located south of Europe
options.C: Antarctica lies at the North Pole
options.D: Asia is located west of Europe

mcqs.answer: Africa is located south of Europe
mcqs.explanation: On a world map Africa lies directly south of Europe across the Mediterranean Sea. Option A is false (Asia is largest); C is false (Antarctica is at the South Pole); D is false (Asia is east of Europe).

mcqs.learning_point: Compare the relative positions of continents
mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes the relative position of South America to Africa?

options.A: South America is east of Africa
options.B: South America is west of Africa
options.C: South America is north of Africa
options.D: South America is south of Africa

mcqs.answer: South America is west of Africa
mcqs.explanation: When looking at a world map, South America lies to the west of Africa across the Atlantic Ocean. Option A reverses the direction; C and D are geographically inaccurate.

mcqs.learning_point: Recognise major geographical features of continents
mcqs.question: Which pair correctly matches a continent with one of its major geographical features?
mcqs.explanation: The Himalayas are a prominent mountain range in Asia. The Sahara Desert is in Africa, not Antarctica; the Amazon Rainforest is in South America; the Gobi Desert is in Asia, not Australia. Hence only option B is correct.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand that continents contain diverse physical environments
mcqs.question: Which statement best reflects the diversity of physical environments within continents?

options.A: All continents are covered entirely by deserts
options.B: Each continent has a uniform climate throughout
options.C: Continents include a range of physical environments such as mountains, plains, deserts, and forests
options.D: Physical environments are the same on every continent

mcqs.answer: Continents include a range of physical environments such as mountains, plains, deserts, and forests
mcqs.explanation: Option C accurately describes that a single continent can host many different landforms and climates. Options A, B, and D are absolute statements that contradict the known geographical diversity of continents.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the seven continents?
mcqs.explanation: Greenland is the world's largest island, not a continent. Africa, Europe, and Australia are all recognized continents. Hence option C is the correct answer.

mcqs.learning_point: Locate continents on a world map
mcqs.question: On a standard world map, which continent is located directly north of Australia?
mcqs.explanation: Asia lies directly north of Australia across the Arafura and Timor seas. Africa, Antarctica, and South America are positioned elsewhere relative to Australia, making them incorrect choices.
